title: A Letter for the Cipher
author: Kestrel Delacroix
blurb: Quentin Ashgrove, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
